title: Coherent ordered-word presentation of actions, modules and balanced bar pairings
statement:
Use the simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent functor spaces and full subcategories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], cocartesian edges and fibers of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and monoidal infinity-categories of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category]. Enlarge the universe to contain the category of finite nonempty linear orders. Put $W_k=(\Delta/[k])^{\mathrm{op}}$, allowing all finite nonempty linear orders in place of its equivalent ordinal skeleton. An object is a monotone labelled vertex string $x:I\to[k]$; its letters are adjacent label pairs. Operators are opposite commutative triangles, so consecutive blocks are contracted, empty blocks insert units, and exterior blocks can be discarded. An operator is inert precisely when the underlying interval inclusion is strictly increasing and preserves adjacency. In $W_2$ the local words have labels in $\{0,1\}$ or $\{1,2\}$; cellular words have no adjacent jump from $0$ to $2$; mixed cellular words contain all three labels. The local words include into the cellular words. On a mixed word, retaining vertices labelled $1$ gives its nonempty bar index, while deleting them gives an output word in $W_1$, with labels $0,2$ relabelled $0,1$. These are functors. The inclusion of the retained outside vertices defines total-contraction arrows, both before and after collapsing labels $0,1$ to $0$ and label $2$ to $1$.

A coherent left action is a cocartesian fibration $p:E\to N(W_1)$ whose fibers decompose, by the actual inert transports, as products of their adjacent-letter fibers. Empty products are terminal. Its all-$0$ restriction is monoidal in the recorded convention; its $11$-letter fiber is equivalent to the point. The $00$ and $01$ fibers are respectively the left monoidal category and the acted-on category; the $11$ fiber is the trivial right monoidal category. An algebra/module family is a coherent diagram over its specified word-base map carrying inert operators to cocartesian edges, in every parameter vertex. A pure $0$ diagram is an associative algebra, including all unit and higher substitution data. A local diagram over the collapse $W_2\to W_1$ specifies $(B,P,A)$ and $(A,Q,*)$ with their common $A$ identified. Restriction to pure $0$ and pure $1$ gives its left and middle algebras.

For a fixed algebra $B$, the coherent category $\operatorname{LMod}_B$ is the full subcategory of inert-preserving $W_1$-sections of $p$ with pure-$0$ restriction $B$. The section/base and algebra equations are equalizers in the internal functor simplicial sets, imposed on every simplex. Thus transformations fix $B$ and higher simplices retain the same compatibility data. Evaluation at the $01$ letter reads the underlying module object in the total category, lying in the acted-on fiber. Uncurrying gives the ordered-word evaluation of any coherent family in this module category.

A bar transport consists of a cellular input family $G$, an output module-word family $Y$ indexed by the retained middle vertices, and a coherent cylinder $H$ whose endpoints are the mixed input evaluation and $Y$, and whose component at each mixed word is a cocartesian edge over the specified total contraction. A balanced, $B$-linear pairing is an inert-preserving extension $D$ of $G$ to all of $W_2$: its $02$ letter is the output module $N$, and its operation $01,12\to02$ is the pairing with all balancing and linearity substitution simplices. Restriction to outer colours $0,2$ reads $N$. Its normalized bar augmentation is a coherent cylinder $\varepsilon:Y\to N$ over the constant output-word base and restricting to the identity on $B$, together with a coherent triangle whose first edge is $H$, second edge is $\varepsilon$, and long edge is exactly $D$ evaluated on the outside-vertex total contraction. All these definitions retain the entire nerve and all parameter simplices, and assume no colimits.
